feeds.title: Oxygen | True Crime Buzz
feeds.description: Get the latest true crime news on Oxygen. Coverage of the latest true crime stories as well as the best TV shows, movies and podcasts in the genre. From reopening investigations to providing exclusive interviews with serial killers, Oxygen Media is the true network for the crime.

feeds.title: True Crime Report Blog
feeds.description: True Crime Report will be focusing on the topic of true crime. This will include both solved and unsolved murders and disappearances, cases involving unidentified remains, serial killers, and other cases involving such things. I want to give the voices back to victims who can no longer use their own voices. Sharing their stories will help shed more light on other similar cases and maybe even help solve some.

feeds.title: Bonnie's Blog of Crime
feeds.description: This blog is crime related, mostly concerning violent crime, especially murder or sex crimes. My focus is mostly on the victim and on justice. The victim needs to be always the center and focus of justice. Bonnie's Blog of Crime shares posts about Crime, Murder, Missing People, Cold Cases, Death Row and Fugitives.

feeds.title: Defrosting Cold Cases
feeds.description: Defrosting Cold Cases is a website with information about unsolved homicides, the missing and the unidentified, wrongful convictions, and book reviews. On here, you'll find articles about old, unsolved cases from the pre-DNA era. They need renewed media attention. The active investigations of these cases is left to professionals.

feeds.title: Jim Fisher True Crime
feeds.description: Welcome to the Jim Fisher True Crime blog, a place for people interested in crime, criminal investigation, policing, law, writing, and forensic science. Jim Fisher is a graduate of Westminster College (Pennsylvania) and Vanderbilt University Law School. He is the author of twelve non-fiction books on crime, criminal investigation, forensic science, policing, and writing.

feeds.title: CrimeBlogger1983
feeds.description: I am CrimeBlogger1983 and I dive deep into cases until I can unearth the truth. I am an Investigative Blogger who mainly covers disappearances but I do cover True Crime in general. I have assisted Law Enforcement in the past on Missing person cases. I have a YouTube Channel as well as a Podcast. I am an aggressive and determined individual.

feeds.title: Open Mind Crime Cook
feeds.description: Explore the intriguing world of food and crime on Open Mind Crime Cook. Join us on this captivating blog for mouthwatering recipes and true crime stories. Delve into riveting cases, infamous criminals, and gripping investigations as we uncover the truth behind some of the most shocking events in history. From unsolved mysteries to high-profile trials, our curated content offers in-depth analysis, compelling narratives, and thought-provoking discussions.

feeds.title: True Crime Society Blog
feeds.description: True Crime Society shares insights, reports and updates on the investigation stories on their blog along with podcasts and forums. If you're not prepared to be a crime connoisseur, look away. True Crime Society primarily focuses on crime and missing people.

feeds.title: Forensic Files Now
feeds.description: Updates to episodes of Forensic Files

feeds.title: Odd Murders & Mysteries
feeds.description: Odd Murders & Mysteries is dedicated to reporting crime without sensationalism and avoiding erroneous assumptions about victims. Media reports of crime should focus on the victims, the crimes, and the facts of the case. At Odd Murders & Mysteries, this is the standard we strive for.

feeds.title: Robin Lyons Blog
feeds.description: Hello, I'm Robin Lyons. When I'm not writing fiction, I'm researching true-crimes to spotlight on my True-Crime Blog page that also inspire new mystery/thriller stories. My hard-hitting, true-crime posts aim to inform you.

feeds.title: True Case Files
feeds.description: True Case Files sheds light on missing, unsolved, true crime stuff. Visit the website to read more about the dark of the world. This website is a compilation of cases involving real life crimes. The write-ups include missing persons, unsolved murders, resolved cases, and other suspicious cases. The purpose of this blog is to spread awareness about the cases.

feeds.title: True Crime South Africa Blog
feeds.description: Stay up-to-date with the most recent blog by True Crime South Africa. Read about true crime cases, movies and book reviews, listen to the podcast, and much more! Nicole Engelbrecht is a podcaster, writer, storyteller, creator, and a true crime addict. She is the creator and host of the popular True Crime South Africa podcast.

feeds.title: Crimes & Curiosities
feeds.description: A true crime blog covering a broad range of cases - from serial and mass killers, to abductions and disappearances, to unexplained events and other curiosities. Freya is an aspiring true crime writer with a BA in Criminology and an MA in Sociology. She is a blogger of all things macabre and bizarre.

feeds.title: The Yard: Crime Blog » True Crime
feeds.description: The Yard is a crime blog where you can find Crime Fiction, and True Crime, from the best writers. The Yard: Crime Blog Is an online magazine about crime, horror and darkness. We publish True Crime and Crime Fiction in all its categories. We also publish Horror and Dark Literature.

feeds.title: Western Telegraph » True Crime UK
feeds.description: The Western Telegraph is a Welsh regional newspaper covering Pembrokeshire and bordering Carmarthenshire. Its True Crime UK series features authentic accounts from journalists who covered the cases first-hand.

feeds.title: Dying Words
feeds.description: The DyingWords blog provides provoking thoughts on life, death, and writing. I'm Garry Rodgers, a retired Royal Canadian Mounted Police (RCMP) Serious Crimes detective and investigator with the British Columbia Coroners Service. I also served as a marksman (sniper) on SAS-trained Emergency Response Teams, so I've got a bit of experience around life and death. Now, I'm an international best-selling crime writer and deadly blogger.

feeds.title: RadarOnline » True Crime
feeds.description: Keep up with the recent true crime news and read the stories with RadarOnline. RadarOnline is the most influential and trusted pop culture, celebrity and entertainment news brand in the world. The leading site was founded in 2003 and is focused on agenda setting celebrity journalism, true crime, fashion and pop culture.

feeds.title: Stories of the Unsolved
feeds.description: Stories of the Unsolved is examining the world of solved and unsolved cases. Stories of the Unsolved is a website born out of two passions: writing and true crime. Since its launch in 2018, it has evolved into a place where work is done to raise awareness about unsolved cases, primarily murders and disappearances, in the hopes of helping the families of those involved find some closure.

feeds.title: Murder Map
feeds.description: Murdermap.co.uk was founded by a group of crime and court journalists with the intention of tracking every homicide in London and making this information freely available to the public. The murdermap project began in 2010 with the aim of covering every single case of murder and manslaughter from crime to conviction to reveal the stories behind the crime figures.

feeds.title: Morbidology
feeds.description: Here at Morbidology, we focus on the obscure, bizarre, and morbid stories from all over the world. Morbidology is a award-winning weekly true crime podcast created and hosted by Emily G. Thompson. Using investigative research combined with primary audio including 911 calls, interviews and trial testimony, Morbidology takes an in-depth look at some of the world's most heinous murders.

feeds.title: Pen & Sword Blog » True Crime

feeds.title: The Crime Talk

feeds.title: GrimCrime » True Crime

feeds.title: Baddie Book Reviews » True Crime
feeds.description: The Baddie Book Reviews blog offers candid and unfiltered reviews of mystery, thriller, horror, and true crime novels. Posts about True Crime written by Baddie Book Reviews.

feeds.title: The Atavist Magazine » True Crime

feeds.title: Crime Reads » True Crime

feeds.title: True Crime Discussion
feeds.description: Read true crime stories, unsolved cases, mystery and more only on True Crime Discussion. Find out about cases from the 1800s as well as recent incidents. The author has compiled a list of over 800 true crime stories.

feeds.title: The True Crime Blog
feeds.description: My name is Trevor Shelby, I'm an Oklahoman who loves to investigate crimes that happened in my state and also all across the United States. I have a bachelor's degree in criminal justice and a love for true crime. We also launched our website TrueCrime.Blog as a personal blog and look into the research I am doing.

feeds.title: True Crime Seven Blog
feeds.description: True Crime Seven is about creating content that explores the dark corners of the world. With a small group of diverse writers, we tackle stories from unknown murderers to infamous serial killers. We share the stories and the details of our findings, and we will have you, the reader, reach your conclusion.

feeds.title: As Close to Crime
feeds.description: I know I'm not the only one who's interested in reading about crime & criminals. I hope to use this blog to share that interest with others. My process is to find something in an old newspaper, news broadcast or my memory that grabs my attention and delve deep. I research the cases and people using newspaper and magazine archives, genealogy sites plus court or prison documents

feeds.title: Serial Killer Shop Blog
feeds.description: Our true crime blog features the most gruesome serial killers. This is a library of the best serial killer stories in history + current criminals. We sell limited edition hand drawn serial killer shirts and horror apparel. Designed, printed & shipped from California.

feeds.title: Crime Magazine
feeds.description: Crime Magazine is about true crime: organized crime, celebrity crime, serial killers, corruption, sex crimes, assassinations, justice issues, crime books, crime films and crime studies. With the purpose of writing about true crime in an authoritative, fact-based manner, veteran journalists J. J. Maloney and J. Patrick O'Connor launched Crime Magazine. Their goal was to cover all aspects of true crime.

feeds.title: True Crime Magazine
feeds.description: Brought to you by world's top experts in true crime world, the True Crime e-Magazine offers an exclusive and fascinating journey through the criminal mind! Visit the website to check out the editors' picks, the photo archive, and their shop.

feeds.title: CANADA UNSOLVED
feeds.description: Canada Unsolved is a voice for Canada's missing, murdered & unidentified. Investigating untold, under-reported cold cases. Canada Unsolved is an investigative blog dedicated to the search for answers to Canada's cold cases, missing persons and unsolved murders. The goal of these stories is to provide new details and insight about each person and the circumstances of their case.

feeds.title: Chicago Crime Tours Blog
feeds.description: Escape into Chicago's underworld on a crime and mob tour with stops on-and-off the climate-controlled bus. Walking tour paths explore historic crime scenes with great photo opportunities on true crime stories. Many Great Articles About Related Topics Covered On the Chicago Crime Tours and Experience Blog such as Chicago Gangsters, Mobsters, True Crime History, Unique and Best Things To Do and Top Attractions.

feeds.title: Crime Traveller
feeds.description: Articles on crime telling real life crime stories including individual cases of violence and murder, historical true crime, the dark worlds of serial killers and their psychology and the stories of some of the most heinous crimes and criminals from around the world. feeds.title: Postpartem
feeds.description: Visit the Postpartem blog for regular content on stories of murders, kid killers, serial killers, female killers, mass shooters and unsolved cases.
